versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for flexible 1688 shop data querying.
- Supports ReAct-based workflow: RAG semantic API matching + live API calls.
- Provides modular interaction cards for API selection, time range selection, and data export options.
- Enforces strong data authenticity—no fabricated or estimated data.
- Automatic mapping of user queries into correct API parameters (e.g., time range/device enums).
- Handles errors and ambiguous cases with clear user guidance and interaction prompts.
